description: Structural rubric: MCP guidance is present in shared context, reference doc, and generated mdde skills.

expectations.text: `.cursor/skills/references/mcp-workbench.md` exists and names official playwright, duckdb (MotherDuck), and serena servers.
`.claude/agents/_mdde-repo-context.md` links the MCP workbench and the three server families.
Generated `mdde-context/SKILL.md` embeds `.claude/agents/_mdde-repo-context.md`, including the MCP workbench section.
Each generated `mdde-*/SKILL.md` (except `mdde-context`) points agents at **mdde-context** for stack rules, so MCP guidance is reachable without duplicating the reference in every file.
`read-memories` and `plan-to-pr` SKILL.md files reference `mcp-workbench.md` and state when to use DuckDB or Serena MCP.
